questions.question: Ratio of divisor to remainder is 3 : 2 and ratio of divisor to quotient is 7 : 12. If the remainder is 14, then the remainder when the dividend is divided by 9 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Divisor: remainder = 3 : 2 ----- (i)

Divisor: quotient = 7 : 12 ----- (ii)

Multiply equation (i) by 7 and equation (ii) by 3

⇒ Divisor : remainder : quotient = 21 : 14 : 36

Divident = divisor × quotient + remainder

⇒ 21 × 36 + 14 = 770

According to question

⇒ 770/9 = 85 + 5/9

∴ Remainder in this case = 5

questions.question: If, a : b = 2 : 3, then (3a + 4b)/(4a + 5b) is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A : b = 2 : 3

**Calculation:**

Putting the value of a and b 2 and 3 respectively in the equation, we get

⇒ {3 × 2 + 4 × 3}/{4 × 2 + 5 × 3}

⇒ {18}/{23}

⇒ 18 : 23

questions.question: Ramesh is thrice as old as Suresh. Two years hence, Ramesh will be twice as old as Suresh. Ramesh’s present age (in years) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ramesh is thrice as old as Suresh

After two years Ramesh will be twice of Suresh

**Calculation:**

Let the present age of Ramesh be 3x and of Suresh be x

According to question:

⇒ (3x + 2)/(x + 2) = 2 / 1

⇒ 3x + 2 = 2x + 4

⇒ x = 2

∴ Ramesh’s age = 3 × 2 = 6 years

questions.question: A man bought 15 articles at ₹ 70 each, 13 at ₹ 60 each and 12 at ₹ 65 each. The average price per article (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

15 article bought at Rs. 70 each

13 article bought at Rs. 60 each

12 article bought at Rs. 65 each

**Formula used:**

Average = total sum/total number

**Calculation:**

Cost of 15 articles = 15 × 70 = Rs. 1050

Cost of 13 articles = 13 × 60 = Rs. 780

Cost of 12 articles = 12 × 65 = Rs. 780

Total of all the articles = 1050 + 780 + 780 = Rs. 2610

Total number of articles = 15 + 13 + 12 = 40

∴ Required average = 2610/40 = 65.25

questions.question: A and B can complete a work in 20 days and 30 days respectively. A works full time but B works half time. In how many days the entire work is to be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 20 days

B can complete the work in 30 days

**Calculation:**

LCM of 20 and 30 = 60

Let the total work be 60 units

Efficiency of A = 60/20 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of B = 60/30 = 2 units/day

But according to question A work full day and B works for half day.

∴ Efficiency of A = 3

And, efficiency of B = 1

So, now the new efficiency of A and B when they worked together = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

∴ Work will complete in = 60 / 4 = 15 days

questions.question: A solid brass sphere of radius 15 cm is drawn into a wire of diameter 6 mm. The length (in cm) of the wire is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of sphere = 15 cm

Diameter of wire = 6mm

**Concept used:**

Volume of sphere is 4/3 × π × r³

Volume of cylinder is π × r² × l

**Calculation:**

Radius = Diameter/2 = 6/2 = 3 mm = 0.3 cm

Volume of sphere = Volume of wire (cylinder)

⇒ 4/3 × π × 15³ = π × 0.3² × l

⇒ l = 50000 cm

Percentage of passing students in 2016 = 30%

questions.question: In how many years, an amount becomes three times of itself, if simple interest is calculated at a rate of 10% per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal becomes 3 times of itself

Rate% = 10%

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (principal × time × rate)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the principal be x

According to question

Simple interest = Amount – principal

∴ Simple interest = 3x – x = 2x

Now, 2x = (x × 10 × time)/100

⇒ Time = 20 years

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] Shortcut Trick__**

Principal is becoming 3 times of itself.

At 10% rate of interest

Means there is 200% raise in the principal amount

Percentage increase = rate × time

∴ 200/10 = 20 years

questions.question: The average temperature of first three days of the week is 23° C; the average temperature of next three days is 24° C and the average temperature of whole week is 23.5° C. The temperature on the last day of the week is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average temperature of first three days = 23°C

Average temperature of next three days = 24°C

**Calculation**

Total temperature of 1st 6 days of week = 23 × 3 + 24 × 3 = 141

Total temperature of week = 7 × 23.5 = 164.5

∴ Temperature of last day = 164.5 – 141 = 23.5

questions.question: A box contains 780 bananas out of which 130 bananas are rotten and rest are of good quality. The percentage (correct to two decimal places) of good quality of bananas is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Box contains 780 bananas

Rotten bananas = 130

**Calculation:**

Good quality bananas = 780 – 130 = 650

∴ Percentage of good quality bananas = (650/780) × 100 = 83.33%

questions.question: A man buys a single article at ₹ 16. If he were to buy a dozen articles, he would have to pay a total amount of ₹ 160. What would be the approximate percent discount (correct to nearest integer) he would get on buying a dozen articles?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A single article can be bought at Rs. 16

If a dozen article he bought he have to give Rs. 160

**Calculation:**

According to question

Cost of one article = Rs. 16

Cost of 12 articles = 16 × 12 = Rs. 192

But he gave Rs. 160

Hence, discount = 192 – 160 = 32

∴ Discount percentage = [(32/192)] × 100 = 16.66% ≈ 17%

questions.question: A train 180 m long moving at the speed of 20 m/sec passes across a boy who is moving at a speed of 10 m/sec in the direction of the train. The time (in s) taken by the train to overtake the boy is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 180 m

Speed of train = 20 m/sec

Speed of boy = 10 m/sec

**Calculation:**

When train and boy moves in the same direction, then relative speed = 20 – 10 = 10 m/sec

We know, distance = speed × time

⇒ 180 = 10 × time

∴ Time = 18 sec

questions.question: If Shivan walks at the rate of 19 km/h. How much time (in minutes) will he take to cover 665 m?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Shivam walking speed = 19 km/hr

Speed in m/sec = 19 × (5/18) = 95/18 m/sec

**Calculation:**

We know, distance = speed × time

⇒ 665 = (95/18) × time

⇒ Time = (665 × 18)/95 = 126 sec

Or, Time = 126/60 = 2(1)/({10)} min

questions.question: The cost price of a camera is 90% of its selling price. The profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of camera = 90% of its selling price

**Formula used**

Profit = selling price – cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price be 100

According to question cost price of camera = 90% of 100 = 90

⇒ Profit = 100 – 90 = 10

∴ Profit percent = (10/90) × 100 = 11.11% or 11(1)/(9)\%

questions.question: What sum will amount to ₹ 24494.40 in 2 years at 8 % per annum, if compound interest is compounded annually?
questions.solution:

Time = 2 years

Rate = 8%

**Calculation:**

Effective rate = {a + b + (a × b)/100} = {8 + 8 + (8 × 8)/100} = 16.64%

Let the principal be x

According to question

⇒ x × (116.64/100) = 24494.40

questions.question: The median of the following set 2, 9, 7, 21, 43, 35, 33, 36, 58, 47 is:
The side of square is a cm. The ratio of its diagonal to its side is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Side of square = a

**Calculation**

Let diagonal be d.

By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ a² + a² = d²

⇒ 2a² = d²

⇒ d²/a² = 2/1

⇒ d/a = √2/1

⇒ d : a = √2 : 1

**∴ The ratio of its diagonal to its side is √2 : 1**
